thread:
nina: Flagging a flaky onboarding issue in the web SDK sample: after a ws->sse fallback we sometimes get tokenized output with chunks shuffled (tokens appear out of order). Repro in webview + flaky carrier.

kev: Can you paste the minimal logs?

nina: sure: 
```[net] ws handshake ok
[net] ws blocked -> fallback to sse-shim
[shim] buffer append seq=10
[shim] buffer append seq=11
[shim] replay start
[shim] emit seq=11
[shim] emit seq=10  <-- out of order
```

oscar: looks like the deque read logic flipped on fallback. Do we ever reverse the buffer for fast path?

nina: we have a fast-path pop_back optimization when converting ws frames to fragments; apparently it runs during shim replay too.

tess: immediate fix: make shim emit strictly by seq. Also add a small reorder-window (default 30ms) to tolerate reordering without dropping.

kev: agree. Also add a lightweight seq header to fragments so server-side logs can be correlated during debugging. That helps support teams.

oscar: we'll need unit tests in shim that simulate interleaving and network toggles. Add an e2e in webview sample that toggles airplane mode.

ops-bot: Reminder: changing shim may affect both web and mobile wrappers. Run cross-sdk integration matrix before canary.

nina: i'll open a WIP PR with seq-enforce + reorder-window and add a short note to onboarding docs. Planning to land after tests. Thanks :thumbsup:
